components.css: .ds-record {border-bottom:1px solid var(--line, #3c3e3f);font-family: var(--sans, Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif);}.ds-record-link {display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.15fr 1.35fr 104px 135px;gap:34px;padding:34px 0 38px;color:var(--fg, #f1f1ed);text-decoration:none;transition:background .2s ease;}.ds-record-link:hover,.ds-record-link:focus-visible {background:var(--panel, #191b1c);}.ds-record-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--fg, #f1f1ed); outline-offset: 6px; }.ds-record h3 {margin:0;font-family: var(--display, "Barlow Condensed", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif);font-size:clamp(30px,2.8vw,42px);line-height:1.08;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.012em;}.ds-target {display:block;margin-top:17px;color:var(--muted, #a8aaa9);font-size:15px;}.ds-record p {margin:0;color:var(--text, #c7c9c7);font-size:17px;line-height:1.6;}.ds-record time {font-family:var(--mono, ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Consolas, monospace);font-size:12px;color:var(--muted, #a8aaa9);white-space:nowrap;}.ds-action {align-self:center;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;font-size:16px;white-space:nowrap;padding:12px 0;}.ds-action svg {transition:transform .2s ease;}.ds-record-link:hover svg {transform:translateX(4px);}svg { stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.4; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; flex-shrink: 0; }@media(max-width:800px){.ds-record-link{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:20px;}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-record-link,.ds-action svg{transition:none;}}

narrative.overview:
A signal-analysis publication: charcoal, chalk, condensed headings, open research rows, and precise SVG rays. The interface gives disclosed findings and readable evidence the strongest visual weight. Dark mode is a binding brand commitment; severity provides the only semantic color scale.

The system is flat and restrained. Horizontal rules organize records, a narrow navigation column supports long reading, and small metadata stays secondary to titles and technical prose. The existing Umbra mark remains paired with a text wordmark.
keyCharacteristics: Charcoal and chalk structure with readable severity colors.
Condensed display type; open, unboxed research records.
A shared reading grid with contents navigation and technical prose.
Precise decorative SVG geometry and brief, optional motion.

rules.name: The Severity Rule
rules.body: Color reinforces a written severity label; it never carries severity alone.

rules.name: The Reading Rule
rules.body: Use condensed type for headings, Barlow for prose, and monospace for technical strings.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Separate publication content with spacing, rules, and tonal feedback; preserve open surfaces.

dos: Do preserve dark mode and the existing Umbra mark.
Do keep severity readable as text alongside its color.
Do preserve semantic headings, native links, dates, definition lists, and generated contents anchors.
Do keep focus visible, code samples keyboard reachable, and reduced motion respected.
Do reuse the shared reading grid and responsive record order.
donts: Don't use severity colors as unrelated brand accents.
Don't introduce shadows, rounded card shells, or ornamental textures into these flat publication patterns.
Don't replace technical prose with display type or set body text in monospace.
Don't hide essential content behind animation or turn the decorative signal into an invented data chart.
Don't publish contact navigation, email addresses, or mailto links; the user requested their omission to reduce scraping.
